acceptedInterpretation: Implement progress and heartbeat for active validate commands so the parent lifecycle idle watchdog sees real liveness, while preserving JSON stdout cleanliness, per-command timeoutMs, forced-exit cleanup, stale-lock safety, and infra-failure classification. This is not permission to disable the watchdog, skip validate, or make timeouts unlimited.
notes: Collision resolved against the tempting interpretation of merely extending/removing the lifecycle idle timeout. The accepted interpretation matches the B-2fb7 checklist and execution plan.
